cues.headline: Rapid!
cues.body: Ivo Corvel just flew past at 25 km/h, the fastest of the match.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 5.0 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Westholm Albion are on top
cues.body: Westholm Albion have taken over: they've had the ball 66% of the time in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: Rapid!
cues.body: Ivo Corvel just flew past at 27 km/h, the fastest of the match.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Westholm Albion 53%, Ravenmoor United 47%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 5.4 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: GOAL! Ivo Corvel!
cues.body: Westholm Albion score! It's Westholm Albion 1–0 Ravenmoor United. The broken game finally produced a goal. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: Westholm Albion are on top
cues.body: Westholm Albion have taken over: they've had the ball 78% of the time in the last 5 minutes. Westholm Albion are already ahead, and still pushing.

cues.headline: Ivo Corvel is everywhere
cues.body: Ivo Corvel has completed 40 passes already.

cues.headline: Pinball out there
cues.body: 4.0 changes of possession a minute: it's frantic and anyone could score.

cues.headline: Niko Everly scores!
cues.body: Get in! Westholm Albion 1–1 Ravenmoor United. It had been coming: Ravenmoor United were in control. It came 2 seconds after Ravenmoor United won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: It's in! Niko Everly!
cues.body: Niko Everly finds the net for Ravenmoor United: Westholm Albion 1–2 Ravenmoor United. It had been coming: Ravenmoor United were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: All square out there
cues.body: It's even again: over the last 5 minutes Westholm Albion have had the ball 44% of the time, Ravenmoor United 56%.

recap.headline: Full time: Westholm Albion 1–2 Ravenmoor United
recap.summary: A deserved win for Ravenmoor United.
